name: Bloodfest Heavyweight Title
epitaph: The fed's own served Champions page names Heywood Jablowme as the sole, current Bloodfest Heavyweight Champion -- no earlier reign or challenger survives in the held record, and the belt's own United States counterpart sits vacant on the same page, "To Be Determined @ Bloodfest Dec.1,2000." One reign anchors the ledger here: the only one attested.

name: Bloodfest United States Title
epitaph: The fed's own served Champions page lists the Bloodfest United States Title vacant, with a title match "To Be Determined @ Bloodfest Dec.1,2000" -- no held document records that match ever taking place, and no earlier reign survives in the held record.

name: Bloodfest Tagteam Titles
epitaph: The fed's own served Champions page names "The Jablowme Brothers" -- Heywood and Sherwood Jablowme, per the fed's own served Roster page -- as the sole, current Bloodfest Tagteam Champions; no earlier reign or challenger survives in the held record.

name: Bloodfest Hardcore Title
epitaph: The fed's own served Champions page names Chaos as the sole, current Bloodfest Hardcore Champion; no earlier reign or challenger survives in the held record, and the corpus never calls his own Fridaynight Warfare win over D-Strange a title defense.
